rule.description: Residue of a closed migration window: an if-limb whose guard strictly folds to the constant False so it can never run, the constant-valued module symbols that only arm such limbs, and every module-scope symbol whose reference paths root only in those limbs.

checks.description: An if-limb guarded by an expression that strictly folds to the constant False at analysis time, so the limb can never run at runtime.
checks.detected_relation: probable-constant guard -> limb that can never execute
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A limb whose guard is provably False is unreachable production code: the migration window it served has closed and the branch can never contribute behavior again.

matches.evidence: Guard `not _rng_layout_migration_complete()` folds to False: the marker returns the literal True, so the legacy RNG-layout rebasing limb can never run.
Guard `_legacy_stateful_sampler_window_open()` folds to False: the staging-era sampler re-wrap limb can never run.
Guard `_LEGACY_BACKEND_ALIASES_ACCEPTED` is a module constant bound to the literal False, so the backend alias-resolution limb can never run.
Guard `_fsdp_legacy_sharding_window_open()` folds to False via the imported gate comparing two module constants with different values, so the pre-v1.15 field normalization limb can never run.
Guard `_fsdp_legacy_sharding_window_open()` folds to False via the same imported gate, so the legacy FSDP variable re-emission limb can never run.

checks.description: A module-scope symbol whose package references all root in limbs detected by expired-compat-limb, transitively through other such symbols.
checks.detected_relation: support symbol -> exclusively dead reference paths
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Helpers, tables, and classes that exist only to serve never-running limbs are dead production weight; removing the limbs strands them.

matches.evidence: Only reference is the never-run RNG-layout rebasing limb in load_accelerator_state.
Only reference is the never-run sampler re-wrap limb in prepare_data_loader.
Only reference is inside _resolve_legacy_backend_alias, itself referenced only from the never-run alias-resolution limb.
Only reference is the never-run backend alias-resolution limb in PartialState._prepare_backend.
Only reference is the entry helper _adapt_legacy_plugin_args, itself referenced only from the never-run plugin normalization limb.
All references are inside the adapter class _LegacyFSDPPluginAdapter, whose only reference path roots in the never-run plugin normalization limb.
Only reference is the field adapter _adapt_legacy_sharding_strategy, reachable only through never-run limbs.
Only reference is its registration in the field-adapter table, itself referenced only from never-run limbs.
References root only in the field-adapter table and the never-run launcher re-emission helper.
Only reference is the import-binding use inside the never-run plugin normalization limb in __post_init__.
References root only in the field-adapter table and the never-run launcher re-emission helper.
Only reference is the import-binding use inside the never-run legacy variable re-emission limb in prepare_multi_gpu_env.

checks.description: A constant-valued module symbol whose only references arm limbs detected by expired-compat-limb.
checks.detected_relation: constant sentinel -> retired limbs it permanently disables
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The sentinel resolves to a fixed constant and is kept only by the disabled limbs' guard expressions; it is the retirement marker left behind with the window it closed.

matches.evidence: Resolves to the constant True and its single reference is the inverted guard of the never-run rebasing limb.
Resolves to the constant False and its single reference is the guard of the never-run sampler re-wrap limb.
Module constant bound to the literal False; its single reference is the guard of the never-run alias-resolution limb.
Resolves to the constant False (layout-tag comparison of two distinct module constants) and its only references arm the never-run normalization and re-emission limbs in two other files.

excluded.reason: Live, still-supported opt-in: its guard reads an environment variable at runtime (`str_to_bool(os.environ.get(...))`), so the strict folding analysis cannot resolve it and must not flag it. The rule also excludes the limb it guards. Removing this symbol or its limb is a behavior break, not a repair.
Guards driven by installed packages, hardware, or the environment read inputs dynamically and never fold under the strict bar; they are live dispatch, not expired fallbacks.

excluded.symbol: zero-reference production helpers pre-existing in the clean tree
excluded.reason: The rule requires at least one reference in dead context (e.g. `is_tpu_available` has none in-package and predates this task); absent references alone are not credited as this case's smell.
